messages:
lucy: Quick heads-up  were co-running a Partner Spotlight (hybrid) with SignalGrid next Tue 11:30am PT. Format: 10m keynote, 25m live integrated demo (marketplace provisioning + on-device inference), 15m Q&A. Can we confirm tech dry-run Mon 4pm PT?

harry: I can join Mon 4pm. Need to validate two flows: (1) marketplace provisioning -> granted API key, (2) local edge device handshake to our private endpoint. Also check CORS for their embedded widget.

mei: Swag lead here. Order: 130 kits (sticker set, beanie, USB-C multiadapter). 45 kits to EU; customs value declared $25/kit. Courier says last-mile pickup Mon 18:00, delivery Tue 07:30. Will upload manifest + invoices to drive: https://drive.internal/partners/signalgrid-swags (internal). :truck: 

raj: Network/infra notes: partners edge units will initiate outbound TLS to our private staging domain staging-api.redwood-inference.internal:443. They also request a short-lived webhook to receive provisioning success events. We should provision a scoped webhook URL and rotate the secret after the event.

lucy: Good. Harry can you paste the signalgrid redirect URI so I can whitelist it for OIDC on staging? Also we need a short printed cue card for the speaker with the fallback phrasing.

harry: Redirect URI: https://studio.signalgrid.com/oauth/return. Adding to staging allowlist now. For fallback phrasing: "If the hosted model is slow, we will transparently route to the Dedicated Edge pool; attendees will see a brief reconnect message and the demo continues." I'll draft a 2-line plain-language cue.

mei: Courier-bot: please confirm pickup window and whether customs paperwork is attached.

courier-bot: Pickup scheduled Mon 18:00 local. Manifest and customs forms attached to drive folder. Tracking numbers will be posted by 20:00. :package: 

raj: Dry-run checklist for Mon 4pm (30m):
- 16:00 join backstage Zoom (hosted link)
- 16:05 marketplace provisioning flow (harry)
- 16:12 short-lived API token creation + scoped webhook test (lucy/raj)
- 16:18 induce hosted -> dedicated fallback and observe logs (watch `routing-decisions`, `edge-handshakes`)
- 16:26 speaker cue + slide handoff (mei)
- 16:28 final swag manifest check (mei)

harry: Quick smoke command for the routing test (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo-signalgrid-179765' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-flash","prompt":"preflight test","max_tokens":8,"simulate_load":true}'
```
Expected: initial route to hosted; when simulate_load:true triggers fallback record to `redwood-edge-dedicated`. Watch `routing-decisions` stream.

ops-bot: Reminder set: dry-run Mon 16:00 (1797740720). I will ping channel 20 minutes before. :bell:

mei: Volunteer for in-venue kit QA at 8:00am Tue? I can do 8:00-9:00 but need one more person to help with on-site distribution at 09:30.

lucy: I can help 09:30 distribution. Also, please ensure lockbox for high-value swag is at the registration desk.

harry: One more technical ask: can we provide a per-demo rate-limit profile so the partners load test doesn't trip SLO alarms? Suggest a soft quota and inform SRE.

raj: Noted  I'll create a temporary quota policy for the demo session and add a SLO mute window in `alerts` from 11:00-12:30 PT.

lucy: Perfect. If there are no blockers by EOD Mon we'll proceed with the dry-run schedule. Share cue card draft when ready. Thanks all. :sparkles:
